title: Expose equipment differences in derived job selectors
changes: Add an ordinary job-change equipment warning to the three opt-in derived first-record job projections; retain their guarded bytes and source quarantine.
Document the bounded same-seed comparison and keep full job and ability behavior open.
validation: Protected USA Wine ordinary route opened Change Jobs and confirmed Hunter; its notice said Unequipped all items. Initial record matched the paired run; ordinary offsets 07/35 changed 02/02 to 0C/14, and nine other nonzero bytes at 2A and 2C..33 became zero. Screenshots were reviewed; the process closed normally and the server drained. Evidence: target/validation/units/dbg20-ordinary-job-comparison-nl85j_ik/.

Protected paused USA Wine CH-9024 Hunter/Hunt one-shot made two writes with no frame or clock advance and changed only offsets 07/35 in the same 264-byte record. Evidence: target/validation/units/dbg20-hunter-paired-once-wu600y_z/.

Protected projection generation confirms all three warnings and unchanged conditional codes. The first test failed before generation due to the test script using its scratch working directory; the corrected retry passed. Evidence: target/validation/units/dbg20-hunter-warning-projection-d6ve55cx/ and dbg20-hunter-warning-projection-retry-w3rgdg6o/.
limitations: The ordinary route advanced frames while the paired application was paused; the nine extra offsets are observed record changes, not a complete equipment schema. Other jobs, states, learned skills, battle effects, physical devices and native Windows remain unverified.
